_comment: Playlist schema. Daemon reloads on change; new order takes effect at the next transition, never mid-air. Two content families: local files in media/ next to this file (file key), and YouTube links (youtube key) that stream live with ZERO disk: yt-dlp resolves, ffmpeg copy-remuxes into local MediaMTX, OBS reads persistent-retry. Optional per item: source (URL/path for prefetch to resolve), show (series tag for similar-replacement), status (active|dormant; dormant is PARKED in the UI), pinned (true = never evicted, never auto-replaced), duration (seconds override; for streams compresses the wall-clock slot — the E2E uses this; omit for full length), pinned. Ad breaks: ad_every N; the pool is ad_files [...] (local files, downloaded by intake as before) PLUS ad_links [...] (YouTube URLs, played ZERO-DISK through the same stream machinery — spawned live, cut into the ad scene, wall-clock returns; resolve failures skip the break and play on, never black). resolving YouTube needs cookies when the IP is bot-flagged (seen live: 'Sign in to confirm you're not a bot'); YTDLP_COOKIES in secrets.env accepts a cookies.txt path or browser:NAME. Unplayable links are skipped with a CRIT; the loop never blocks a link.
